messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT: High tail latency spike detected in us-west-2 (kv-cache path). p95 jumped from ~380ms -> 1.2s, p99 from ~950ms -> 4.3s over last 10m. Streaming stalls observed; significant paging and slab evictions. Suspected: slot oscillation + prefill vs decode imbalance. Incident page: https://redwood/incident/INC-1759876543 :rotating_light:

sara: I'm on call, starting triage. Paging eng-sre and runtime. Will gather quick diffs and error-rate graph links.

aj: seeing lots of repeated cache-miss -> prefill-start in stream-proxy logs for same keys, decode queue depth is saturating (queue length spikes to 2k). Sample log: `prefill: key=usr:1234 start`, then many `decode: backlog full` messages.

marta: this looks like the prefill/decoder throughput mismatch we saw in feb — prefill floods slab space causing fragmentation, then eviction churn. Could be slab hot/cold oscillation.

kevin: I'll apply an emergency throttle to prefill workers to buy time. Planning to set PREFILL_CONCURRENCY from 40 -> 12 on redwood-prefill-prod-usw2 now.

elena: can you snapshot slab usage and top hot-keys first? run:```kubectl exec -it cache-mgr-0 -c cachectl -- /bin/sh -c "cachectl slab-stats && cachectl hot-keys --top 100"```

kevin: PREFILL_CONCURRENCY update rolled out (1759876598). Early signal: request rate steady, prefill task inflight down ~65%.

aj: after throttle: p95 down to ~650ms, p99 down to ~2.1s. Streaming stalls still showing for long-tail sessions (some tail responses still 6-12s). decode workers still catching up.

sara: scaling up decode pool by +3 nodes (decode-pool-usw2). ops-bot will track.

ops-bot: Scale event submitted: decode-pool-usw2 +3 nodes (requested at 1759876615). Estimated provision ETA ~90s.

marta: we should enable a temporary routing fallback to smaller model variants for requests >8k tokens to reduce prefill pressure. I can flip routing flag if we want.

kevin: fallback routing enabled (flag: prefer-compact-models=on). Route hit rate ~6% of requests right after flip.

aj: customer impact summary: ~240k requests in last 15m experienced elevated tail latency, about 0.7% of total requests. One enterprise customer (AcmeCorp) reported degraded streaming UX; CS already notified and has a support ticket open.

elena: eviction patterns: sudden eviction bursts observed at slab IDs [12,19,24] around 1759876600. Hot-key set is heavily skewed; top 10 keys account for ~18% of slab churn. Prefill tasks were retrying, causing repeated writes to same slots.

kevin: executing targeted low-priority slab eviction to rebalance: `cachectl evict --slabs lowprio --confirm` (dry-run verified). Running now.

aj: eviction executed (1759876672). We saw an eviction spike then a short latency bump for a minute, but overall p99 improved to ~1.4s and streaming stalls rate dropped ~40%.

sara: decode nodes finished joining (ops-bot confirmed at 1759876745). decode queue backlog cleared ~60s later.

marta: recommend we keep PREFILL throttle and fallback routing for at least 30m while monitoring, and schedule a post-incident slab defrag + redistribution job during the next maintenance window.

elena: noted. I'll kick off a background slab-defrag job and add an incr. telemetry hook to capture prefill vs decode rates for the next 2h. Command queued: `jobs run slab-defrag --window=2h --priority=low`.

kevin: Customer-facing note: shared to CS: "We're mitigating elevated latency caused by cache eviction waves; we've throttled prefill, increased decoder capacity, and enabled routing fallbacks. Monitoring shows improvement."

sara: handing off live watch to @marta for next 45m. I'll stay available for escalation.

marta: taking over live mitigation (handoff ts 1759876800). I'll open an incident doc and schedule postmortem. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: INC-1759876543 status=mitigated -> monitoring. severity=SEV2 -> SEV3 (reduced). Next update expected in 30m.

sara: adding follow-ups: (1) postmortem w/ prefill-vs-decode root cause, (2) add automatic prefill-backpressure if decode queue > 500, (3) long-term: slab allocator tuning + hot-key eviction policy.

marta: copy. I'll own the postmortem and follow-ups. Closing handoff thread and will update incident doc with timeline + metrics.

oncall-bot: Thread closed to edits for oncall handoff, monitoring channel: #incidents."
